smdia.label: Standard Maximum Deposit Insurance Amount (SMDIA)
smdia.statement: $250,000 per depositor, per FDIC-insured bank, for each account ownership category.

key_facts.fact: Deposit insurance is automatic for any deposit account opened at an FDIC-insured bank; customers do not buy it.
Coverage protects the balance of each depositor's account dollar-for-dollar up to the limit, including principal and accrued interest through the date the insured bank closes.
Deposits held in different ownership categories at the same bank are separately insured, so one depositor can hold well over $250,000 fully insured at a single bank.
All deposits an accountholder has in the same ownership category at the same bank are added together and insured up to the standard insurance amount.
If you have accounts at different FDIC-insured banks, the limit applies separately at each bank.

Deposit insurance covers checking, savings, money market deposit accounts and CDs. It does not cover stocks, bonds, mutual funds, annuities, life insurance or other non-deposit products, and it does not cover losses from theft or fraud.
Since the FDIC was established in 1933, no depositor has lost one penny of FDIC-insured funds.

ownership_categories.category: Joint accounts (two or more owners, no beneficiaries)
ownership_categories.max_note: $500,000 for a two-owner joint account; each additional qualifying co-owner adds $250,000.

ownership_categories.limit_text: $250,000 per owner regardless of the number of beneficiaries

ownership_categories.category: Trust accounts (informal POD/ITF, formal revocable, irrevocable)
ownership_categories.limit_text: $250,000 per beneficiary: (# of owners) × (# of distinct beneficiaries) × $250,000, not to exceed $1,250,000 per owner for all trust deposits at one bank
ownership_categories.max_note: Per owner, across all trust deposits at that bank.

ownership_categories.category: Corporation, partnership and unincorporated association accounts
ownership_categories.limit_text: $250,000 per corporation, partnership or unincorporated association
$250,000 for the non-contingent interest of each plan participant
ownership_categories.max_note: Depends on the number of plan participants; no single figure applies.

ownership_categories.limit_text: $250,000 per official custodian (more coverage available subject to specific conditions)

tools.name: FDIC Electronic Deposit Insurance Estimator (EDIE)
tools.purpose: Calculate your own coverage across ownership categories at one bank.
